name: johnny_harris
description: Geopolitical documentary — map-driven storytelling, archival flashbacks, conversational authority

global_map_explainer.description: Satellite view → zoom → color fill countries → bold white text labels
global_map_explainer.easing: ease-in-out for zooms, ease-out for fills

conversational_pushin.description: Direct eye contact, mid-shot, very slow imperceptible push-in zoom
conversational_pushin.easing: ease-in-out, nearly linear — should feel subconscious
conversational_pushin.audio: room tone always present, music ducked underneath

archival_flashback_montage.description: Rapid B&W or vintage color clips with original archival audio
archival_flashback_montage.audio_behavior: music drops to let archival audio breathe, then swells back
archival_flashback_montage.treatment: original aspect ratio, film grain, sometimes letterboxed

key_concept_popup.description: Bold white text appears INSTANTLY on the map/location it refers to
key_concept_popup.animation: instant (1-2 frames) or quick scale-up (0.4-0.75s ease-out)
key_concept_popup.sync: precisely timed to the spoken word

journey_arc.description: Curved dashed line animates across map showing connections/routes

whoosh_fast.usage: every map transition, zoom, element appearance
whoosh_fast.prompt_for_generation: fast cinematic whoosh swoosh, short 0.4 seconds, clean, mid-high frequency

hit_hard.prompt_for_generation: deep cinematic impact hit, short 0.4 seconds, low bass thud

ding_subtle.description: Subtle tonal ding marking key text appearance
ding_subtle.prompt_for_generation: subtle notification ding chime, 0.4 seconds, clean high tone

explosion_major.prompt_for_generation: deep explosion boom impact, 0.8 seconds, cinematic, not cartoonish

primary.family: sans-serif (Montserrat, Open Sans, or similar sturdy sans-serif)

boxed_label.usage: country names on maps, entity labels

accent_bar.usage: key phrases, pivotal statements (rare — 2-3 per video)

emphasis_word.usage: single words within boxed labels that need extra weight

color_palette.background: satellite imagery (primary) or flat white/grey outlines (simplified)

map_behavior.simplified_layer: flat white/grey with country outlines only
map_behavior.transition_between: 0.5-1s linear fade from satellite to simplified
map_behavior.region_highlight: solid color fill with slight glow, 0.4-0.6s ease-out
map_behavior.border_draw: red line traces the border, 1-2s linear
map_behavior.person_overlay: circular or polygonal cutout of leader's head placed on their country

music_behavior.silence_pattern: music drops to SILENCE before almost every important direct statement
music_behavior.swell_pattern: music swells on reveals, montages, map reveals
music_behavior.beat_alignment: beats align with cuts during montage sequences
music_behavior.ducking: music ducks 60-80% under speech, drops to 0% for key statements

pacing.pattern: slow TH → fast montage → slow TH → fast montage (oscillating energy)

talking_head.framing: mid-shot, slightly off-center, maps visible in background
talking_head.background: world map on wall, personal items visible

map_segments.density: start sparse, add layers progressively, don't dump everything at once
